purpose: Define 50 independently addressable digital role presets and their bounded composition contract.

operating_model.independent_role_preset: Each role owns a versioned Role Profile, Role Playbook, Skills, artifact contract, evaluation suite and Access boundary.
operating_model.complex_case_composition: External Case Control composes bounded role workers around accepted Stage Artifacts; one lead owns the Case result and workers do not use implicit peer chat.
operating_model.execution_boundary: The model emits Action Intent only; Policy Gate and Execution Broker outside the model decide and execute assets.
